class.name: CgameHTNPlanner
class.brief_description: Deterministic Hierarchical Task Network planner for game AI.
class.description: Native port of the Cgame GDScript HTN planner, in the style of the planners used by Horizon Zero Dawn and Transformers: Fall of Cybertron. The domain is plain data: - A compound task is an [Array] of methods tried in declaration order. Each method is a [Dictionary] [code]{"preconditions": {key: value}, "subtasks": ["a", "b"]}[/code]. - A primitive task is a [Dictionary] [code]{"preconditions": {key: value}, "effects": {key: value}}[/code]. Planning decomposes depth first, simulates effects on a copy of the world state and backtracks to the next method whenever a branch dead-ends. Results are fully deterministic. [codeblock] var domain = { "root": [{"preconditions": {}, "subtasks": ["kick"]}], "kick": {"preconditions": {}, "effects": {"open": true}}, } var plan = CgameHTNPlanner.plan(domain, "root", {}) # ["kick"] [/codeblock]

method.name: plan
method.description: Returns the primitive task names to execute, or an empty array when [param root_task] cannot be decomposed within [param max_steps] expansions (this also terminates recursive domains). Unknown tasks and methods whose preconditions do not hold in the simulated state are skipped. Preconditions compare each key with [code]==[/code] semantics against [param state].
